tools.name: audit_mcp_contracts
tools.description: Audit supplied MCP tools/list descriptors and compare with optional previous_tools to flag likely breaking changes. No network requests or storage of your schemas. Returns structured findings and a SHA-256 fingerprint.

tools.name: ecosystem_catalog
tools.description: Discover project-owned complementary MCP tools useful for a specific agent task. No automatic call, login, payment or referral tracking.

tools.name: check_demo
tools.description: Run a controlled synthetic health check and store its result. NOT an external service probe.

tools.name: check_live
tools.description: Perform a real HTTP check ONLY against Guardian's own fixed test target. Globally rate-limited to one check per minute. Not third-party monitoring.

tools.name: live_history
tools.description: Read real HTTP observations of Guardian's own test target from the last 24 hours, including sample size, availability, and latency.

tools.name: demo_history
tools.description: Read measured synthetic check history over the last 24 hours. NOT independent uptime monitoring.
